name: Horng Terng
summary: Horng Terng Automation Co., Ltd. specializes in developing and manufacturing advanced machinery tailored for the LED and solar energy sectors. Their extensive product portfolio encompasses a variety of inspection systems, including visual inspection, electrical testing, and dark collapse detection machines. They also provide solutions for adhesive application, offering both general dispensing equipment and specialized glue dispensing and printing machinery. Rounding out their offerings are automated material handling and connection systems, such as product exchange machines, loading equipment, and automatic connection units. Established in 1994, the company is headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
